_description: PHI guard pattern definitions for MedCodeTranslator. Hard violations block PRs. Warnings are informational. See agents/phi-guard/README.md and docs/SAFE_SCOPE.md.

hard_violations.description: PHI-named field or parameter declared in TypeScript (in a type, interface, function signature, or object literal)
hard_violations.message: PHI-named identifier detected in TypeScript. Patient-identifiable data is prohibited — see docs/SAFE_SCOPE.md.

hard_violations.description: Clinical decision support field declared in a TypeScript type or interface
hard_violations.message: Clinical decision support field detected. These features are out of scope — see docs/SAFE_SCOPE.md.

hard_violations.description: fetch() call to an absolute external URL inside app/ or db/ layer
hard_violations.message: External HTTP request detected in app/db layer. Verify no user query data is transmitted to third-party endpoints.

hard_violations.description: AsyncStorage call with a PHI-adjacent key string
hard_violations.message: AsyncStorage key contains a PHI-adjacent term. Patient data must not be persisted — see docs/SAFE_SCOPE.md.

warnings.description: Variable declaration with 'patient' prefix in app/db code
warnings.message: Variable name starts with 'patient'. Confirm this does not handle patient-identifiable data.
